user_signal.goal_or_constraint: Completely distill all ten Skills, including workflow, methodology and non-obvious system dimensions, into one normalized Skill library before selecting what to use.
user_signal.counterexample: The first pass selected/adapted find-skills immediately after inspecting only rank #1, creating ordering bias and failing the requested complete-before-selection research process.
user_signal.proposed_mechanism: Build a complete Skill library first, then perform cross-Skill comparison and selection only after 10/10 completion.

falsification_checks: inspect delegated primitives for thin wrappers rather than judging wrapper length
inspect executable runtime and evals where behavior lives outside SKILL.md
preserve source-authored known failures and evidence gaps
freeze final selection until all ten normalized entries exist
compare selected primitives against current Universal authority to prevent duplicate mechanisms

sources.observation: find-skills is an executable discovery/acquisition funnel with deterministic non-interactive behavior, not merely a recommendation prompt.
sources.rationale: Reuse-before-build is useful; fixed popularity thresholds/global installation defaults are not universal quality rules.

sources.observation: Several top-ranked Skills are intentionally tiny wrappers over shared primitives, while source docs also acknowledge that prose-only cross-Skill loading can fail.
sources.rationale: Thin routing is valuable only when responsibility has a stronger home and loading/execution is observable or enforced.

sources.observation: The strongest inspected architecture combines thin discovery Skill, runtime-versioned instructions, executable isolation/state semantics, context-footprint measurement and behavioral/live evals.
sources.rationale: Use as an architecture reference for progressive disclosure, context measurement, uncertain mutation outcomes and final-state verification without copying browser-specific implementation.

sources.observation: Frontend-design contains strong brief-grounded creative methodology and anti-default critique but lacks comparable dedicated mechanical quality evidence in the inspected surface.
sources.rationale: Keep owner-local for visual work rather than globalizing subjective design heuristics into Universal kernel.

alternatives.rationale: Creates rank/order anchoring and prevents fair cross-Skill deduplication.
Pins comparable evidence for all ten first, then permits primitive-level selection against current architecture.
Would import contradictory assumptions, duplicated responsibilities, prompt-only guarantees and owner-local methods into the kernel.

instruction_surface.reason: The gap was the research/evolution process and evidence normalization, not ChatGPT account/startup routing. The library is cold-path research and must not enlarge the startup prompt.

propagation.mechanism: No owner business rule or shared production invariant is changed by creating/selecting the library; later promotions require their own owner/control-plane change and regressions.
propagation.reason: This run records research and selection; production promotion is intentionally separate.

inspected_paths: vercel-labs/agent-browser:discovery Skill + runtime core Skill + session/trust/snapshot refs + evals
superseded_or_demoted_surfaces: research/SKILL_DISTILLATION_01_FIND_SKILLS_2026-10-11.md is historical and superseded for current Top10 selection by the normalized library entry + Phase B report

second_order_findings: Popularity ranking was explicitly prevented from becoming quality ranking.
A short SKILL.md was not treated as evidence of simplicity; delegated runtime/reference/harness surfaces were followed.
Prompt-specified workflows were separated from mechanical enforcement/eval evidence.
Selection was delayed until 10/10 completion to remove first-seen/order anchoring.
Production promotion remains separate so learning evidence does not silently mutate active kernel semantics.

open_gates: Selected cross-agent primitives have not yet been promoted into production Universal policies/runtime/harness.
Frontend-design owner-local adoption/eval has not been performed.
No claim is made that Top10 popularity predicts quality or that every source Skill improves our real outcomes.
closure.unknown_or_open_world_boundary: The library covers the pinned source revisions and inspected implementation/eval surfaces. Future upstream revisions, uninspected private telemetry, and real-world owner outcome effects remain outside current evidence.
